paragraphs.text: Arius , the Flyby Trawler , is the Chordatan pirate and member of the Keelhaulers racing team under Captain Howler that participated in the Ghirapur Grand Prix . He originates from an unknown plane submerged in water and has taken up residence on Avishkar .
Arius appears as a hammerhead Chordatan, a humanoid shark, who is known for flying via a rocket-powered glider and carries a net of cannonballs. He traveled to Muraganda with his team.
Arius was a member of Howler's boisterous crew that bristled against the restrictive rules placed upon them by the Grand Prix but stayed in line for the most part.
